auditor_singh: Hi team — audit follow-up: we need a compact evidence package for an RBAC tweak that impacted the serviceAccount `inference-runner` on 2025-06-18. Request: (1) PR/commit that made the RBAC change, (2) exact deploy timeline, (3) KMS Decrypt events for alias rdw-inference-key in the deploy window, and (4) any vuln/ops notes linked to the change. Where should we pull these artifacts from?

leo_oncall: Hey @auditor_singh — PR + CI artifacts + CloudTrail + k8s audit should do it. We have a one-command exporter for these so we can bundle and sign.

maria_infra: PR link: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4957, merge commit b7f3e90 (merged 2025-06-18T22:10:05Z). CircleCI job 11021 applied rollout: `kubectl apply -f rollout-20250618.yaml` at 2025-06-18T22:10:33Z. I saved CI artifact `deploy-20250618-2210.json` to s3://redwood-audit/ci-artifacts/2025/06/18/deploy-20250618-2210.json.

rahul_sec: For KMS decrypts: query CloudTrail for eventName=Decrypt and requestParameters.keyId containing `rdw-inference-key` between 2025-06-18T22:05:00Z and 2025-06-18T22:20:00Z. Splunk sample: 
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt "rdw-inference-key" | table _time, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.encryptionContext, sourceIPAddress
```

auditor_singh: Will the CloudTrail output let us prove the decrypt was triggered by the service account instead of just the node role? Auditor needs binding proof.

rahul_sec: Yes. Our KMS client includes encryptionContext set to `service_account:inference-runner` on decrypt calls. CloudTrail shows the assumed-role principalId but includes requestParameters.encryptionContext — that ties the decrypt to the service account. We'll include both the CloudTrail JSON and a filtered CSV that highlights the encryptionContext field.

maria_infra: Also captured k8s audit snippet that shows the SA token exchange/binding: s3://redwood-audit/k8s-audit/2025/06/18/sa-bind-2210.json. It includes the exact verb and the subject referencing `serviceAccount/inference-runner`.

leo_oncall: I'll run the exporter: `redwood-audit export --from 2025-06-18T22:05:00Z --to 2025-06-18T22:20:00Z --keys rdw-inference-key --include-ci --include-cloudtrail --include-k8s --out s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1798888888-inference-runner-bundle.tar.gz`. Exporter will generate `timeline.csv` and `mapping.txt` mapping artifacts to SOC2 CC6.1 / ISO A.9.

evidence-bot: Evidence export started by leo_oncall. Job ID eexp-c7d2.

rahul_sec: Vulnerability note linked in the PR: INFSEC-1309. Summary: Memcpy use in a third-party library flagged; we updated the dependency to v2.1.4 and applied a runtime mitigation (input sanitization) in the same deploy. No active exploit observed. I'll add `INFSEC-1309-summary.txt`.

auditor_singh: Please include a short causal timeline (10s granularity) tying PR merge -> CI -> k8s rollout -> decrypt events so we can show the decrypts were invoked by restarted pods after the RBAC change. Also list full authoritative locations for artifacts and state any redactions applied.

maria_infra: Artifact list I'll include in `mapping.txt`: 1) PR #4957 (github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4957) 2) merge commit b7f3e90 (github.com/redwood/inference/commit/b7f3e90) 3) deploy-20250618-2210.json (s3://redwood-audit/ci-artifacts/2025/06/18/deploy-20250618-2210.json) 4) CloudTrail decrypt JSON (s3://redwood-audit/cloudtrail/2025/06/18/decrypt-events-22-23.json) 5) k8s audit SA bind snippet (s3://redwood-audit/k8s-audit/2025/06/18/sa-bind-2210.json) 6) vuln triage INFSEC-1309-summary.txt (s3://redwood-audit/triage/INFSEC-1309-summary.txt).

rahul_sec: Redactions: we redact node hostnames and customer IPs. We preserve principal ARNs, encryptionContext values, serviceAccount names, and timestamps. Each artifact includes a SHA256 checksum file.

leo_oncall: Export complete: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1798888888-inference-runner-bundle.tar.gz (sha256: f1a9...)

auditor_singh: Received. I'll validate and comment if anything missing. If auditors request raw CloudTrail we can provide with an NDA. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria_infra: For internal record we also captured pod env snapshot (internal-only): s3://redwood-audit/forensics/pod-env-20250618-2210.json.

leo_oncall: Marking this thread resolved unless auditor reopens for deeper correlation.

auditor_singh: Acknowledged — thanks everyone.
